mapper.sql: id, account_id, code_hash, expires_at, attempt_count, verified_at, pass_token_hash, pass_expires_at, used_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_password_reset ( account_id, code_hash, expires_at, created_at ) VALUES ( #{accountId}, #{codeHash}, #{expiresAt}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM account_password_reset WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND verified_at IS NULL AND expires_at > #{now} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM account_password_reset WHERE pass_token_hash = #{passTokenHash} AND verified_at IS NOT NULL AND used_at IS NULL AND pass_expires_at > #{now} FOR UPDATE
